info.name: WiseCub Virtual Stock Market
info.description:
Scenarios for the Virtual Stock Market API on http://127.0.0.1:8000.

Import this file + WiseCub Local environment. Keep FastAPI running.
For all 15 event types at once: Runner → this collection → select postman/data/vsm-event-types.json on the data-driven request, or run the Events folder.

exec: pm.test('demo company uses index', function () { pm.expect(j.symbol).to.eql('NSEI'); });

request.description: Run the collection with postman/data/vsm-event-types.json selected as data file.
